# HoldRead

`schemas/api/hold.json`

One record of GET /v1/holds (docs/design/m0/15 D2; 02 "Hold reasons and resume signals"): a hold in force, on a node (records/node-hold) or on a lease (lease.waiting, lease.restore_failed; 05), in one shape. A lease records only the hold and its signal instance, so a lease hold has no id, project, reason, concrete owner or since (null) and no pages; its owner is the hold's registry owner. A node hold's project is its node's.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | null or [HoldID](common-defs.md#holdid) | The node hold's id; null for a lease hold. |
| `held` | yes | one of `node`, `lease` | What holds: a graph node or a lease. |
| `subject` | yes | [TypeID](common-defs.md#typeid) (pattern `^(nod\|lea)_`) | The node's (nod_) or the lease's (lea_) id. |
| `project` | yes | null or [ProjectID](common-defs.md#projectid) | The node's project; null for a lease hold, read only under an every-project read. |
| `hold` | yes | string (pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`) | The hold (schemas/vocab/holds.yaml). |
| `reason` | yes | null or [ReasonCode](common-defs.md#reasoncode) | The reason of the result that raised a node hold; null otherwise. |
| `signal_instance` | yes | string (minLength `1`, maxLength `1024`) | The concrete signal that resumes it. |
| `owner` | yes | [Owner](vocab-registry.md#owner) |  |
| `owner_ref` | yes | null or string (minLength `1`, maxLength `256`) | The concrete owner, as records/node-hold has it; null for a lease hold. |
| `since` | yes | null or [Time](common-defs.md#time) | When a node hold's wait began; null for a lease hold. |
| `pages` | yes | array of object ([fields](#fields-of-pages)) | A node hold's paging history, oldest first, as records/node-hold has it; a lease hold is not paged yet. |

No other fields are allowed.
